research_objective: Use control-replay GRPO to improve the SFT-initialized Qwen3.5-4B on retry/safe-end residuals without forgetting stability controls, then exceed the fixed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B reference on a new entity-disjoint sealed benchmark.

units_and_metrics.primary_metric: mean entity-level complete-trajectory pass rate over both detectors and all primary scenarios

sealed_test_objective.strong_superiority_if: entity-clustered paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound for target_grpo minus larger_reference is greater than zero
sealed_test_objective.if_point_estimate_wins_but_interval_cros: Report point-estimate superiority only; do not claim stable superiority.
sealed_test_objective.if_objective_fails: Do not rerun or rescore the V10 sealed test; open a new study version with a new sealed test.

anti_leakage_rules: V10 train, two support blocks, selection-dev, and both sealed-test cohorts use disjoint entities and protected values.
V9 selection-dev outcomes may motivate the anti-forgetting recipe but cannot enter V10 train, support, selection, or sealed rows.
The larger-reference selection-dev or sealed-test result cannot select a target checkpoint.
Support or promotion thresholds cannot be relaxed after sampling begins.
